items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 162:1
items.html: Because the screen of phase two is included together with the Parsa that concludes Atzilut, the screen becomes the aspect of a literal screen, separating all the illumination of Hochma from the Hassadim. See above, answer 52. (Item 31).
